description: This file contains unit tests for the ApplicationManagementServer component, verifying initialization, state changes, start, and stop behaviors using a test fixture and mock interactions.

methods.name: shouldInitialize
methods.description: Test that the application manager initializes successfully.

methods.name: shouldNotInitializeIfClientInitalizationFails
methods.description: Test that initialization fails when client initialization fails.

methods.name: shouldChangeState
methods.description: Test that the application manager can change state to ACTIVE.

methods.name: shouldNotChangeStateIfClientNotConnected
methods.description: Test that state change fails if client is not connected.

methods.name: shouldStart
methods.description: Test that the application manager starts correctly.

methods.name: shouldStop
methods.description: Test that the application manager stops correctly.
